title: LStepBetaRow
html:
定义组：指标替换与规约。有序参数：z989、z990、z991。

指定策略的一步规约；非规约传递闭包。：单行局部条件。

规范公式

(@ LStepBetaRow z989 z990 z991) 按 无捕获缩写规则 展开为下列有限公式。参数只取集合，不能填入函数项或元语言公式。

(exists t
  (exists u
    (and
      (@ Pair t u z991)
      (and
        (@ AnyRaw t)
        (and
          (@ AnyRaw u)
          (or
            (exists z994
              (exists z995
                (exists z997
                  (exists z998
                    (and
                      (@ Num0 z994)
                      (and
                        (@ TApp z995 z998 t)
                        (and (or (@ ULam z997 z995) (exists z996 (@ TLam z996 z997 z995))) (@ LInst z994 z998 z997 u))))))))
            (or
              (exists z999
                (exists z1000
                  (exists z1001
                    (and
                      (@ TApp z999 z1000 t)
                      (and
                        (@ TApp z1001 z1000 u)
                        (exists z1005
                          (exists z1006 (and (in z1005 z990) (and (@ App z989 z1005 z1006) (@ Pair z999 z1001 z1006))))))))))
              (or
                (exists z999
                  (exists z1000
                    (exists z1002
                      (and
                        (@ TApp z999 z1000 t)
                        (and
                          (@ TApp z999 z1002 u)
                          (exists z1007
                            (exists z1008 (and (in z1007 z990) (and (@ App z989 z1007 z1008) (@ Pair z1000 z1002 z1008))))))))))
                (or
                  (exists z997
                    (exists z1003
                      (and
                        (@ ULam z997 t)
                        (and
                          (@ ULam z1003 u)
                          (exists z1009
                            (exists z1010 (and (in z1009 z990) (and (@ App z989 z1009 z1010) (@ Pair z997 z1003 z1010)))))))))
                  (exists z996
                    (exists z997
                      (exists z1003
                        (and
                          (@ TLam z996 z997 t)
                          (and
                            (@ TLam z996 z1003 u)
                            (exists z1011
                            (exists z1012 (and (in z1011 z990) (and (@ App z989 z1011 z1012) (@ Pair z997 z1003 z1012)))))))))))))))))))

直接依赖

AnyRaw；App；LInst；Num0；Pair；TApp；TLam；ULam
